verdict.rationale: Stripe docs explicitly describe Elements/Checkout embedded on your own site as an alternative to redirecting to a Stripe-hosted page, allowing fully customizable in-app payment UI (stripe-docs-1, stripe-docs-2, stripe-docs-23, stripe-docs-50). This is well-documented first-party capability with clear API references (Checkout Sessions API, Elements). missing for 10: no independent/hands-on developer confirmation specifically of embedded Elements customization (community evidence is generic Stripe sentiment, not about embedding).
